card.name: Dosing schedule and supply units
card.fires_on: Words that complete a time-or-count unit in dosing directions, such as 'daily' after 'once', 'supply' after '7-day', or 'pack' and 'tablets' after missed-pill counts.

modes.label: Once daily
modes.description: The word 'daily' right after 'once' in dose instructions.
modes.example: The usual recommended starting dose of candesartan cilexetil is 16 mg once<< daily>> when it is used as monotherapy in

modes.label: Pack or supply length
modes.description: A noun for the amount of product or days it covers, such as pack or supply.
modes.example: At 1600 µg/day, a bottle of SYNAREL provides about a 7-day<< supply>> (about 56 sprays).

modes.label: Missed tablets in a row
modes.description: The word 'tablets' after consecutive missed-pill counts in contraceptive directions.
